question: What are the most influential papers on RNA interference? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on RNA interference, based on citation counts, include foundational studies on genetic interference in C. elegans and the use of 21-nucleotide RNA duplexes in mammalian cells.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/35888","title":"Potent and specific genetic interference by double-stranded RNA in Caenorhabditis elegans","citation_count":13226},{"doi":"10.1038/35078107","title":"Duplexes of 21-nucleotide RNAs mediate RNA interference in cultured mammalian cells","citation_count":8557},{"doi":"10.1038/nature01957","title":"The nuclear RNase III Drosha initiates microRNA processing","citation_count":4415},{"doi":"10.1038/35053110","title":"Role for a bidentate ribonuclease in the initiation step of RNA interference","citation_count":4146},{"doi":"10.1038/418244a","title":"RNA interference","citation_count":3724}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on RNA interference, based on citation counts, include foundational studies on genetic interference in C. elegans and the use of 21-nucleotide RNA duplexes in mammalian cells.
